sources: references/manuals/T660/Highland Technologies T660 Programming Guide.pdf page 92

t660_1.role: continuous reference/probe/frame-input clock from explicitly calibrated settings

t660_2.A: one positive Fire command per authorized electrical event
t660_2.B: one positive Q-switch command per authorized electrical event
t660_2.C: negative process trigger at every scan opportunity; inactive high
t660_2.terminal_frame: One additional finite frame with A/B/C/D all disabled; no scan index or spectral trigger. Count against upload capacity and elapsed duration.
t660_2.predivider: selected measured_scan_period_s * calibrated probe_frequency_hz, validated integer

upload: Use existing T660Service.preload_frame_table; pending-field changes only, STORE acknowledgment progress and cancellation; hold ownership through restoration and preservation.
timing_basis: Programmed edges describe the commanded schedule. Aligned native sample timestamps minus independently observed pump timestamps define reconstruction; T660 nominal insertion delay is not an optical calibration.
stationarity: Accept an immediate unpumped qualification scan train before arming a whole finite one-pump movie. Qualification has its own all-disabled terminal frame. Also retain every declared pre-pump and pump-crossing scan.
forbidden: slowing the scan to fit memory
